title: 3. Agents and clients walk the graph themselves

sections.name: summary
sections.label: In short
sections.content: The core stores a graph but has no walk, so every client writes its own and agents do not walk at all.

sections.name: body
sections.label: The evidence
sections.content: Reach (an n-hop walk, srs-rust#1413) and lineage (#1416) were built in clients. Strata's walk is about 40 lines, and at 3 hops on muSrs it reaches all 139 problems, so a cap is needed. Clients stitch the whole graph from many calls (#1415). A hub with 782 authored-by edges forced the bounded neighbours tool (#1229). A context read inlines whole neighbours and costs about 6.5k to 9k tokens (srs-context finding 030997a9, SP-22). The zero-context agent never walked the tree and invented prerequisites (finding bbe9faf9).

sections.name: open
sections.label: Open
sections.content: Is a walk a core service or a DiscoveryQuery axis? One way per goal says not both.
